highlights: GPT-6 Astra 可直接读写模型权重
vLLM v0.33.0 升级 PyTorch 并放弃 CUDA 12.9
SGLang v0.5.23 支持 TPU7x 与低延迟内核

items.title: GPT-6 Astra 可直接读写模型权重
items.summary:
研究者在博客中展示，GPT-6 Astra 能直接读取神经网络权重判断网络行为，并在不写训练循环、也不用环境反馈的情况下修改权重：修复 Qwen3.5-0.8B 数学能力时只改动 0.016% 的权重，同一采样设置下 MATH-500 从 7.9% 升到 48.1%，IFEval 提升 3 倍。
这被称为 Weight-Space Programming，若经得起复核，意味着模型优化可能不再局限于梯度下降和符号优化器。

evidence.quote: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights

Likewise, asked to make Qwen3.5-0.8B better at math without gradients, Astra identifies an issue in its weights causing reasoning loops that Qwen’s own model card warns about, and fixes this by natively editing 0.016% of the weights .
With the same sampling settings, this weight correction raises MATH-500 from 7.9% to 48.1% and generalizes out of the box to instruction following, raising IFEval by 3x.
All of this is possible without allowing Astra to write training loops.
We call this Weight-Space Programming .

In Weight-Space Programming , a general-purpose LLM reads and writes a network’s weights directly (i.e., not through an optimizer, and in particular not with gradient descent) around some natural language spec, sometimes even with no environment feedback at all.

items.title: vLLM v0.33.0 升级 PyTorch 并放弃 CUDA 12.9
items.summary:
vLLM v0.33.0 包含 927 个提交、389 位贡献者，升级到 PyTorch 2.14.0、torchvision 0.29.0 和 Triton 3.8.0，同时发布 wheel 和镜像只保留 CUDA 13.0，CUDA 12.9 的 wheel 与 -cu129 镜像不再发布。
新版本加入 Reflection Beam-1.0 等模型支持、推测解码与多硬件加速，开发者升级前需要检查 PyTorch 与 CUDA 版本兼容性。

evidence.quote: This release features 927 commits from 389 contributors (122 new)!

New models : Reflection Beam-1.0 (501B MoE, 23B active) with its DFlash2 drafter ( #62074 ), Yandex AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B ( #57963 ), Recursive Flint (40B MoE, 2.5B active) ( #62938 ), Muse Spark Open ( #61879 ), Step-5 Preview ( #61727 , #63147 ), NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super ( #62957 ), Nemotron-L
PyTorch 2.14 : vLLM is upgraded to PyTorch 2.14.0, with torchvision 0.29.0 and Triton 3.8.0 ( #52183 ).
CUDA 12.9 dropped : release wheels and images are CUDA 13.0 only.
The CUDA 12.9 wheels and the -cu129 / -cu129-ubuntu2404 images are no longer published ( #62575 ); use the default CUDA 13.0 artifacts instead.

items.title: SGLang v0.5.23 支持 TPU7x 与低延迟内核
items.summary:
SGLang v0.5.23 合并了 1007 个 PR，新增 Muse Spark Open、MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 等模型支持，并通过 SGLang-TorchTPU 在 Google TPU7x 上运行。
新版本提供 NVIDIA megakernel 和 AMD monokernel 低延迟模式，以及在单张消费级 GPU 上运行超出显存容量 MoE 模型的 Paged Experts 选项。

evidence.quote: 1007 PRs from 257 contributors.
Muse Spark Open
MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
Paged Experts (opt-in) runs MoE models larger than GPU memory on a single consumer GPU, up to 30x faster than CPU offload ( #42557 , #45787 ).
SGLang now runs on Google TPU7x through SGLang-TorchTPU , a PyTorch-native plugin for TPU.
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.23

items.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview 统一语音、推理与工具调用
items.summary:
ServiceNow-AI 发布开源语音语言模型 Apriel Voice 27B Preview，基于 post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B 构建，在共享推理骨干内直接处理语音并生成回复和工具调用，不需要单独的对话模型。
模型通过两阶段训练适配语音并使用在线蒸馏，思考模式下在 Big Bench Audio 得分 98.90、Speech-BFCL 得分 81.13、τ-Voice 任务成功率 65.51%，平均延迟 1.91 秒。

evidence.quote: le Gauthier Melançon + 9 authors Abstract Apriel Voice 27B Preview is an open speech-language model that integrates speech understanding, reasoning, and tool use within a shared backbone, achieving strong results on audio benchmarks through a two-stage training procedure with online distillation.
We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities.
Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a separate dialogue model.
We introduce a two-stage training procedure to adapt the model to speech.

Automatically constructed speech-conditioned dialogues provide conversational training data, while local teacher serving, overlapping teacher and student computation, and fused full-vocabulary losses enable efficient online distillation .
In thinking mode, Apriel Voice achieves a score of 98.90 on Big Bench Audio , 81.13 on Speech-BFCL , and a task success rate of 65.51% on τ-Voice , with a mean latency of 1.91 seconds.

items.title: REA 用异步运行时协调机器人快慢策略
items.summary:
REA 提出统一运行时，让审慎的 System 2、具身路由 System 1 与反应式 System 0 策略协作，核心规则是正在运行的策略不等待大脑，并通过路由记忆、边界触发的判断门和共享预算升级阶梯完成恢复。
在 60 个 LIBERO-Pro 任务的 3,000 次测试回合中成功率 95.9%，控制步数减少 25%、控制时间减少 17%，并迁移到 BEHAVIOR-1K 和真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人。

evidence.quote: in Wang , Wangbo Zhao , Yang You Abstract REA unifies deliberative and reactive policies in a single runtime with asynchronous coordination, achieving high success rates with reduced control overhead across simulated and real robot tasks.

To address this, we propose REA (Routed Embodied Agent), a unified runtime where a deliberative System 2 , an embodied router System 1 and reactive System 0 policies cooperate under a single golden rule - no running policy waits on the brain.

Instead of querying the brain at each failure, REA employs a route memory that stores each policy's measured success ahead of time, a boundary-triggered judge gate that consults the brain on policy execution, and a shared-budget escalation ladder for bounded recovery.

Evaluated on 3,000 test episodes across 60 LIBERO-Pro tasks, REA reaches 95.9% success and beats the best single-agent baseline in its own policy pool (94.7%) while reducing control steps by 25% and control time by 17%.
REA also transfers to BEHAVIOR-1K and a real Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving the highest observed success among the compared methods.

items.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B 面向轻量 Agent 场景
items.summary:
Nanbeige 团队发布 Nanbeige4.3-33B，将其定位为 Nanbeige4.3 系列的旗舰教师模型，后续用于把 Agent 能力蒸馏到更小的模型。
该模型支持最长 524,288 tokens 上下文，可用 Transformers、SGLang 或 vLLM 部署，模型卡给出的成绩包括 Terminal-Bench 2.1 为 80.9、Terminal-Bench 4.0 为 23.8、DeepSWE 为 65.5。

evidence.quote: In Nanbeige4.3, we take a foundational step toward pushing the boundaries of lightweight agents.
To this end, we first introduce Nanbeige4.3-33B, designed as the flagship teacher model for the Nanbeige4.3 series.
Delivering state-of-the-art agentic performance among open models in the ~30B parameter class, Nanbeige4.3-33B excels at complex coding and professional cowork tasks.
Agentic Coding Terminal-Bench 2.1 2 80.9 73.0 61.8 47.2
Terminal-Bench 4.0 3 23.8 6.3 1.6 0.0
The model supports a context length of up to 524,288 tokens (512K).

items.title: R²Orch 用递归自博弈训练 Agent 编排器
items.summary:
R²Orch 提出递归自博弈编排范式：内层自博弈让 Proposer 自行选择任务训练编排器，外层循环则改进内层循环本身，并引入 Recursive Learnability 训练目标和 Skill Withdrawal 机制。
作者称其在十二个数据集的问答、数学、代码与交互任务上稳定超过基线，代码已放出。

evidence.quote: g , Qiang Huang , Yanjin Li , Rui Qian , Qichao Zhao , Tiesunlong Shen , Na Zhao , Jian Wang , Xiaoying Tang Abstract R²Orch uses recursive self-play with learnable task selection and skill withdrawal to train orchestrators without hand-designed curricula, improving performance across reasoning and

To address these challenges, we propose R^2Orch, a new paradigm of Recursive Self-Play Orchestration: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrator on self-chosen tasks, and an outer loop that improves how the inner loop improves.

To support this paradigm, we introduce Recursive Learnability , a training objective that rewards a Proposer for choosing tasks whose rollouts keep reaching different outcomes as skills are withdrawn.

Built on this objective, we further propose Skill Withdrawal , in which the outer loop withdraws each skill once a controlled evaluation within self-play shows that the orchestrator performs as well without it.
Experimental results on twelve datasets show that R^2Orch consistently outperforms baselines across question answering, math, code, and interactive tasks.
Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/R2Orch.

items.title: FrameForge 用视频模型先验统一图像生成
items.summary:
FrameForge 把条件生成建模为输入自适应的虚拟时间关系，在预训练视频模型上用 Mixture of Temporal Experts 动态选择不同虚拟间隔的 temporal RoPE 专家，并用 Chain of Temporal Reasoning 的推理瓶颈注意力掩码引导信息传播。
在 DreamBench、COCO2017 和 GEdit-Bench 上，作者称该方法在主体驱动生成、canny-to-image 生成和图像编辑上优于对比方法。

evidence.quote: ng Zhang Abstract FrameForge enables adaptive conditional image generation by modeling variable condition-target relationships through dynamic temporal experts and intermediate reasoning pathways in pretrained video models.
Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions.
This motivates us to model conditional generation through input-adaptive virtual temporal relations.
Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) models how far the target lies from the condition by dynamically selecting temporal RoPE experts with different virtual intervals.

Chain of Temporal Reasoning (CoTR) models how the condition is transformed into the target through a latent intermediate state, with a reasoning-bottleneck attention mask encouraging information propagation through this pathway.

Experiments on DreamBench, COCO2017, and GEdit-Bench show that FrameForge achieves superior performance in subject-driven generation , canny-to-image generation, and image editing among the compared methods.

items.title: SimpleLoRIF 定位削弱安全性的微调数据
items.summary:
SimpleLoRIF 用梯度嵌入找出与不安全行为梯度对齐的微调样本，把反向传播限制在最后四个 transformer block，从而可处理百万量级的数据集。
作者据此构建 SafeTulu，移除 Tulu 3 中最对齐的 20% 样本后，跨 Qwen、Llama 和 Olmo 的 GCG 攻击成功率最多下降 22%，同时基本保留甚至提升模型能力，数据集与可定制 Space 均已发布。

evidence.quote: mpleLoRIF uses gradient alignment to filter instruction data that silently degrades LLM safety, yielding a safer dataset that reduces adversarial success while preserving capabilities.
We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF , a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior.

By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks , SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training dataset
We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu , a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed.

Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge and prior gradient-based filtering, while largely preserving or even improving capability.

We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.

items.title: OSWAM 用一步扩散生成动作
items.summary:
OSWAM 为自动驾驶与具身控制提出一步动作生成的世界动作模型，用 imagination tokens 初始化扩散过程以提供物理先验和动作条件表示，并通过带未来条件的特权信息蒸馏增强动作生成。
作者称 OSWAM 在两项任务上取得与需要数十步的直接策略 WAM 和 Joint-WAM 相当或更好的结果，相对直接策略 WAM 基线约有 3 倍加速，编译后推理延迟在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上低至 40ms。

evidence.quote: tract OSWAM enables real-time, high-quality action generation in autonomous driving and embodied control by initializing diffusion with structured imagination tokens and distilling future-conditioned privileged information into a single denoising step.

To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM , for autonomous driving and embodied control.
Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations.
We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation.
As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step.
Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps.
It obtains approximately 3times speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU.

items.title: agent-desktop 开源跨平台桌面操作 CLI
items.summary:
vercel-labs 发布 agent-desktop，一套面向 AI Agent 的桌面操作 CLI 和 C 库，覆盖 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，通过操作系统无障碍树读取并操作桌面应用，不依赖像素匹配。
每次调用返回带元素 ref 的 JSON 快照，Agent 按 ref 操作后再次快照校验，并提供 FFI 以便在进程内直接调用，适合把桌面操作能力接入 Agent 循环。

evidence.quote: Computer use for AI agents: read and operate desktop apps through the OS accessibility tree.
A CLI and C library for macOS, Windows and Linux.
A snapshot returns JSON with a ref for every element an agent can act on.
The agent acts on a ref and snapshots again to check, with no pixel matching; the loop stays in your agent.
Install on macOS, Windows or Linux with npm:
npm install -g agent-desktop
Each release also ships libagent_desktop_ffi for macOS, Linux and Windows, so a program can call the tool in process instead of starting the CLI for each command.

items.title: Latent Sparse Attention 开源超长上下文稀疏注意力
items.summary:
研究团队发布 Latent Sparse Attention (LSA)，面向超长上下文的次二次注意力方向，在 10M tokens 下把稀疏注意力最高加速 22.7×，全注意力加速 72.4x。
作者称 LSA 在超长上下文上匹配全注意力的精度，并公开内核、SGLang 集成、论文与细节，方便在本地部署更长上下文时降低注意力成本。

evidence.quote: Post Log in Sign up Post Log in Sign up James Whittington on X: "Today we are happy to share one of our first open research releases: Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), a step towards subquadratic attention that matches accuracy of full attention at ultra-long context.
At 10M tokens, that search takes 98% of the attention layer's time.
LSA makes sparse attention up to 22.7× faster and full attention 72.4x faster.
